record.paper: Subdivisions in digraphs of large out-degree or large dichromatic number

dossier_meta.paper: Subdivisions in digraphs of large out-degree or large dichromatic number
dossier_meta.statement_text: If $F_1$ and $F_2$ are $\delta^+$-maderian, then the disjoint union of $F_1$ and $F_2$ is also $\delta^+$-maderian.
dossier_meta.context_text: Alon's Conjecture 6 would imply this. Partial positive answers follow from the Erdős–Pósa property: Theorem 8 shows that if $F$ is $\delta^+$-maderian and has the Erdős–Pósa property, then $k \times F$ is also $\delta^+$-maderian for all positive integers $k$.
